Empty string value for the city field (field present, value is ""). Must be flagged MISSING, not treated as an unmatched fuzzy candidate against an empty string.

Whitespace-only value (field present, three spaces). Must normalise to empty and be flagged MISSING before any fuzzy comparison is attempted. Quoted so the leading/trailing/only spaces survive CSV parsing.

Field absent entirely from the JSON payload, as opposed to present-but-empty (TC-17) or present-but-blank (TC-18). Sentinel <ABSENT> instructs BookingBuilder to omit the key rather than set an empty value — CSV has no native way to encode 'no such key', so this convention stands in for it.

JSON null literal for the field. Sentinel value 'null' (unquoted, lower case) instructs BookingBuilder to serialise the field as JSON null, not the three-character string "null". Third variant of missing alongside TC-17 (empty) and TC-19 (absent key) — proves all three collapse to the same MISSING reason.
